description:
✨ Unwind in this romantic and serene 1BHK serviced apartment featuring a private Jacuzzi, tucked away in the peaceful neighborhood of Candolim — just minutes from the beach and Goa's vibrant dining scene.

🌿 The apartment blends modern elegance with a relaxed coastal vibe. Step out into the balcony overlooking tranquil greenery, take a dip in the pristine swimming pool, or unwind in the warm bubbling jacuzzi.

💻 High-speed fiber Wi-Fi with power backup ensures smooth remote working, while a fully equipped modular kitchen and cozy living lounge make it your perfect home away from home.

reviews.name: Smit
reviews.comment: The apartment is amazing and looks even better than the photos! The private jacuzzi was so relaxing after exploring Candolim beach. Michelle and Neha were incredible hosts — super responsive, hospitable, and gave wonderful restaurant recommendations.

reviews.name: Shivani
reviews.comment: We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was spotless, beautifully designed, and loaded with thoughtful amenities. The shared swimming pool was pristine and tranquil. Will definitely book again when visiting Goa!

reviews.name: Garima
reviews.comment: Loved the calm villa vibe! The bedroom is very spacious, bed is super comfy, and having a private jacuzzi inside the apartment made our anniversary stay extra special.

reviews.name: Siddhant
reviews.comment: Great place for remote working! The dedicated desk with fast Wi-Fi and power backup was seamless. Even during heavy Goa rains, everything functioned smoothly. Michelle was always just a message away.

reviews.name: Debjyoti
reviews.comment: Super peaceful environment, close to the Candolim beach strip yet far enough to enjoy peaceful quiet evenings on the private balcony.

reviews.name: Kajal
reviews.comment: Everything was pristine! Clean linens, well-maintained jacuzzi, great kitchen utensils, and prompt host communication. Highly recommended!

locationDetails.description: Candolim is one of Goa's most beloved coastal destinations. Known for its golden sand beach, peaceful atmosphere, vibrant shacks, water sports, and renowned restaurants like Fisherman's Wharf and Calamari. The apartment is located in a quiet enclave just off the main road, giving you immediate access to supermarkets, pharmacies, and scooter rentals while maintaining tranquility.
